archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Organic & Earthy

brand_identity.description: A high-end productivity tool crossed with a study-craft application. Avoids the typical 'tech SaaS purple' or generic 'Testbook blue'. Focuses on deep concentration, high contrast readability, and organic premium touches to reduce eye strain and build authority.

typography.instructions: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Headings must be tight. Overlines must be wide. Mono font is exclusively for the Mock Test timer, code snippets, and short-tricks.

descriptions.primary: Deep Evergreen (#0A2518) - Used for primary actions, heavy text, deep contrast containers.
descriptions.secondary: Warm Sand (#F0EBE1) - Used for soft backgrounds, AI explanation blocks, and subtle active states.
descriptions.accent: Blaze Orange (#FF5722) - Used sparingly for calls to action, important highlights, 'Ask Doubt' triggers, and the 'Current Question' border.
descriptions.background: Off-White/Paper (#F5F5F4) - Reduces eye strain for long study sessions.
descriptions.success: Green - For correct answers and attempted questions in the palette.

spacing_and_layout.general: Follow generous spacing for marketing pages (p-12, p-24) and tight 'Control Room' grid spacing (gap-4, p-4) for the test interfaces and dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Use CSS Grid. 3-4 columns. Top row: Summary widgets (col-span-1). Middle: Main chart or Daily practice (col-span-2 or 3). Right: Activity Feed (col-span-1 row-span-2).
spacing_and_layout.mock_test_interface: Split layout: 70% left panel (Question & Options), 30% right panel (Palette & Timer). Use h-screen to lock scroll on body, allowing independent scrolling inside the panels.
spacing_and_layout.corners: Rounded-lg (8px) for cards, rounded-md (6px) for buttons. Avoid fully rounded pill shapes except for status badges.

component_styling.cards: Flat background (bg-card), 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-md).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-medium active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform

component_styling.mcq_options: Large clickable blocks. Default: border border-border hover:border-primary/50. Selected: border-primary bg-primary/5. Correct: border-success bg-success/10 text-success. Wrong: border-destructive bg-destructive/10 text-destructive.
component_styling.question_palette_grid: Grid of small square buttons (w-10 h-10). Unattempted: bg-muted text-muted-foreground. Attempted: bg-success text-success-foreground. Marked: bg-warning text-warning-foreground. Current: border-2 border-accent.
component_styling.ai_explanation_block: Soft bg-secondary, p-6, rounded-lg, border-l-4 border-accent. Typography inside should use markdown prose styling but with Satoshi font.

micro_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have a transition. transition-all duration-200 ease-out.
micro_interactions.click: Buttons and MCQ options should scale down slightly on click (active:scale-[0.98]).
micro_interactions.ai_reveal: Expand AI explanation smoothly using Framer Motion (height: 0 -> auto, opacity: 0 -> 1).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over primary buttons is pure white. Muted text must still be readable against background.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements, form inputs, buttons, and dynamic content blocks MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., 'start-mock-test-btn', 'mcq-option-a', 'ai-explanation-toggle').

landing_page.structure: Hero section with large headline, transparent nav (Crystal Glass variant), overlapping images, Bento grid for Exam Categories (SSC, CAT, GATE).
landing_page.visuals: Use dark_learning_bg or hero_background behind the hero section with a heavy overlay if text contrast is needed.

student_dashboard.structure: Grid layout. Stats cards on top. 'Quick Start Daily Practice' as a prominent banner card. Progress Recharts line chart.

mock_test.structure: Fixed header with 'JetBrains Mono' timer and 'Submit Test' button. Left side scrollable questions. Right side fixed grid palette.

performance_analytics.structure: Dense data view. Use Shadcn Table for past tests. Use Recharts for accuracy trends and topic strengths.

admin_panel.structure: Sidebar navigation. Data tables with filters for CRUD operations on questions and tests. Strict, functional layout.

app_logo.usage: Main application logo for header and auth pages.

hero_background.usage: Hero section background on the landing page. Apply a light overlay (bg-white/40 or bg-white/70) for text legibility.

dark_learning_bg.usage: Use as a background for 'Call to Action' banners or inverted dark sections on marketing pages.

progress_abstract.usage: Feature section image representing progression, learning, and mock test improvement.

student_studying_1.usage: Use in 'About Us' or 'Join Community' sections.

exam_preparation.usage: Use for the 'Daily Practice' marketing block or blog header.

library_recommendations.icons: lucide-react (default for UI), @phosphor-icons/react (for sophisticated duotone icons on marketing pages).
library_recommendations.animations: framer-motion (for daily practice option selection and AI reveal).
library_recommendations.components: shadcn/ui (Tailwind customized as per guidelines above).
